summary: Version 0.12.1 is live: the scanner ranks the 50 most traded of the 220 S&P/TSX Composite members, every buy and sell has an entry, a stop (2 × ATR) and a target (3 × ATR) computed by code with risk and reward per share, and the track record follows each signal for 20 sessions (target, stop, expired, open). Claude wrote signals for the 25 new stocks (50 in all). ANT left the scanner at the owner's request; /ant stays, unlinked. ROUTINE.md gives the scheduled run its steps; the routine itself waits for GitHub to be connected. A signal file pushed before the code was live was refused by the old release and the page showed no signals for about ten minutes. The project documents were brought up to date.
delivered: data/scan/candidates.json: 220 Composite members with sectors; list size from the file.
scan/levels.py, ATR(14), stops and targets on the page and in the cards.
track.py: stop or target first, from later highs and lows.
deploy.sh: one install at a time; market.py: plain Yahoo client name; /ant canonical.
README, PRODUCT, ARCHITECTURE, HOW-IT-WORKS, INFRASTRUCTURE, DECISIONS D-038 to D-046, STATUS, BACKLOG; reports 009, 010, 011; devlog 009, 010, 011.
decisions: Confirmed by the owner: swing trading; top 50 of the Composite; stops and targets from ATR; ANT out of the scanner (D-042, D-045).
Proposed: 2 × and 3 × ATR, 20 sessions; a day reaching both counts as the stop.
Deferred: the login, until the public repository and the open Fly.io address are dealt with (D-046).
